scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/handlers/*.ts --outdir dist --root src/handlers --target node --format cjs --external '@aws-sdk/*'
scripts.test:local: AWS_REGION=us-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 bun test
scripts.dev: docker run -d --rm --name pitchdrill-ddb -p 8000:8000 amazon/dynamodb-local >/dev/null 2>&1; until curl -s localhost:8000 >/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; done && bun run dev:table --keep && AWS_REGION=us-west-2 DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 OPENROUTER_SECRET_ARN_ENV=pitchdrill/openrouter-api-key OPENROUTER_MODEL_ENV=anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 bun --watch src/dev/server.ts
